canDoYue: 你識問場合同設計偏好，仲識用假如講訂金同跟進。
canDoEn: Ask about the occasion and the design preference, then use if and would for a deposit and a follow-up.

dialogue.speaker: ada
dialogue.text: Good morning. Is the occasion an anniversary, or an engagement?
dialogue.glossYue: 早晨。呢個場合係週年，定係訂婚？
dialogue.say: Good morning. Is the occasion an anniversary, or an engagement?

dialogue.speaker: nia
dialogue.text: The occasion is an anniversary dinner.
dialogue.say: The occasion is an anniversary dinner.

dialogue.speaker: ada
dialogue.text: If you chose a contemporary gold piece, would you like it understated or more of a bold statement?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果你揀一件現代金飾，你想要低調，定係搶眼啲？
dialogue.say: If you chose a contemporary gold piece, would you like it understated or more of a bold statement?

dialogue.speaker: nia
dialogue.text: I prefer it understated, and I'd keep this gold piece as a quiet investment.
dialogue.glossYue: 我偏好低調，我會當呢件金飾係低調保值。
dialogue.say: I prefer it understated, and I'd keep this gold piece as a quiet investment.

dialogue.speaker: nia
dialogue.text: If I paid a deposit on a custom piece, would the timeline fit my anniversary next month?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果我落訂金做一件訂製首飾，個時間表趕唔趕得切下個月週年？
dialogue.say: If I paid a deposit on a custom piece, would the timeline fit my anniversary next month?

dialogue.speaker: ada
dialogue.text: Yes. I can fit the whole plan into next month.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以。我趕得切下個月成個計劃。
dialogue.say: Yes. I can fit the whole plan into next month.

dialogue.speaker: nia
dialogue.text: If the new design is more modern, I'd still want a quiet gold piece.
dialogue.glossYue: 如果新設計再現代啲，我都想要一件低調嘅金飾。
dialogue.say: If the new design is more modern, I'd still want a quiet gold piece.

dialogue.speaker: ada
dialogue.text: If you confirmed the deposit, I would book a follow-up and keep the design exclusive to you.
dialogue.glossYue: 如果你確認訂金，我會約跟進，同埋將個設計獨家留畀你。
dialogue.say: If you confirmed the deposit, I would book a follow-up and keep the design exclusive to you.
